name: Matsucon
blurb: An anime and manga convention in Oulu, Finland, with cosplay, music and art guest-of-honour programming, run by a volunteer organizing committee.
notes: The most recent confirmed dates found were for the edition that has already happened (8.-9.8.2026, Pohjankartanon koulu, Oulu, per matsucon.fi/tapahtuma/). The homepage (checked 2026-10-05) says the committee thanks everyone for that event and is now recruiting the 2027 organizing committee ('Uuden conitean haku on nyt alkanut! ... MATSUCONIN CONITEAHAKU 2027'); no 2027 dates have been announced yet, so editions is empty.
